crossRefs.note: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.
He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

translations.web: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
translations.bsb: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy
translations.asv: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
